  CASE WHEN day_begin_debit - day_begin_credit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE day_begin_debit - day_begin_credit END,
  CASE WHEN meadow_begin_debit - meadow_begin_credit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE meadow_begin_debit - meadow_begin_credit END,
  CASE WHEN month_begin_debit - month_begin_credit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE month_begin_debit - month_begin_credit END,
  CASE WHEN quart_begin_debit - quart_begin_credit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE quart_begin_debit - quart_begin_credit END,
  CASE WHEN half_year_begin_debit - half_year_begin_credit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE half_year_begin_debit - half_year_begin_credit END,
  CASE WHEN begin_year_debit - begin_year_credit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE begin_year_debit - begin_year_credit END,
  CASE WHEN day_begin_credit - day_begin_debit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE day_begin_credit - day_begin_debit END,
  CASE WHEN meadow_begin_credit - meadow_begin_debit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE meadow_begin_credit - meadow_begin_debit END,
  CASE WHEN month_begin_credit - month_begin_debit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE month_begin_credit - month_begin_debit END,
  CASE WHEN quart_begin_credit - quart_begin_debit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE quart_begin_credit - quart_begin_debit END,
  CASE WHEN half_year_begin_credit - half_year_begin_debit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE half_year_begin_credit - half_year_begin_debit END,
  CASE WHEN begin_year_credit - begin_year_debit <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE begin_year_credit - begin_year_debit END,
  term_end_bal_debit, term_end_bal_credit,
  day_happen_debit, meadow_happen_debit, month_happen_debit, quart_happen_debit, half_year_happen_debit, year_happen_debit,

INSERT INTO VT_C_FIN_GL_SUBJ_BAL_02
SELECT '{ETL_TX_DT}', T1.org_no, T1.currcy_cd, T1.subj_no, NVL(T3.zkemumc,''),
  SUM(CASE WHEN period_dt BETWEEN DATE'{I_TDB_DT}' AND DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' THEN term_end_bal_debit ELSE 0 END), -- 借方旬积数
  SUM(...), ...
FROM FDM.F_FI_FIGL_SUBJ_BAL_TAB T1
LEFT JOIN ODM.O_FIGL_ZSAPKMCS T3
  ON T1.subj_no = T3.zkmuhao AND T3.start_dt <= DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' AND T3.end_dt > DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}'
WHERE T1.period_dt <= '{ETL_TX_DT}' AND T1.period_dt >= '{I_MATTY_DT}'
  AND T1.currcy_cd <> '@RMB' AND MOD(LENGTH(T1.subj_no),2) = 0
GROUP BY org_no, currcy_cd, subj_no, NVL(T3.zkemumc,'')

INSERT INTO CDM.C_FIN_GL_SUBJ_BAL(...)
SELECT DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}', T1.org_no, '', '001', T1.subj_no, T1.subj_lvl_cd, NVL(T3.zkemumc,''), '',
  SUM(T1.last_day_debtor_bal*T2.last_dt_rate_rmb), ...
FROM CDM.C_FIN_GL_SUBJ_BAL T1
LEFT JOIN (SELECT T2.currcy_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN data_dt=当日 THEN dom_currcy_convt_price ELSE 0 END) rate_rmb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN data_dt=上日 THEN dom_currcy_convt_price ELSE 0 END) last_dt_rate_rmb, ...
  FROM CDM.C_COM_EXCH_RATE T2
  LEFT JOIN FDM.F_CO_TRANS_CD T3 ON T2.currcy_cd=T3.STAND_CD_VAL AND T3.STAND_CD_TAB_NO='CCRD0005'
  GROUP BY T2.currcy_cd) T2 ON T1.currcy_cd=T2.currcy_cd
LEFT JOIN ODM.O_FIGL_ZSAPKMCS T3 ON T1.subj_no=T3.zkmuhao AND T3.del_ind<>'D' AND T3.start_dt<=DATE AND T3.end_dt>DATE
WHERE T1.data_dt=当日 AND T1.conve_into_currcy_cd='000'
GROUP BY T1.org_no, T1.subj_no, T1.subj_lvl_cd, NVL(T3.zkemumc,'')
